count_convention: whole deduplicated outline assigned by centroid; exact boundary ties smallest GEOID
size_convention: whole projected EPSG3310 outline area, not clipped fragments
volume_scope: centroid-assigned area-height product on positive finite nonconflicting heights; geometric overlap not unioned; not independent of factors and not whole-land union volume
physical_building_identity: source rooflines may split a physical building or include annexes; no independent physical-building segmentation ground truth
